We are seeking a qualified capital/finance professional to lead the capital and control workstream for new regulated insurance entities established by the Group — including DFSA, Cayman and Lloyd’s structures. Key Responsibilities

  • Lead financial establishment of new regulated entities (DFSA, Cayman, Lloyd’s, etc.) – define opening balance sheet, capital structure, and financial control framework; ensure proper capitalization before business.
  • Build capital adequacy and solvency models for each new entity to meet regulator requirements; maintain and update as the entity grows.
  • Establish regulatory reporting framework for each jurisdiction – design reporting pack, set reporting calendar, produce first returns, then hand over to ongoing support.
  • Develop three‑statement financial model and entity‑level profit & loss; create management reporting suite for ongoing reporting.
  • Set up reinsurance programme accounting structure (quota share, excess of loss, ceding commission); ensure correct accounting treatment and controls; support existing programmes as required.
  • Produce first monthly management accounts and entity‑level reporting pack – define format, commentary, distribution; support ongoing production for existing entities.

  • Run capital adequacy stress testing and scenario analysis across regulated entities – shock loss, premium growth, FX sensitivity; assess headroom above SCR/MCR and inform capital deployment.
  • Manage collateral arrangements for reinsurance programmes – letters of credit, trust accounts, cash deposits; ensure proper sizing, documentation, renewal.
  • Own capital waterfall and inter‑entity funding mechanics – manage dividend upstream, shareholder loan repayment, capital repatriation; ensure movements within limits and documented.
  • Track and report reinsurance counterparty credit exposure – maintain register, flag rating changes, concentration risk, collateral shortfalls.
